mostWorthwhile.text: Mounting the cream horse completed the arrangement of three horses, making the separate fittings visibly add up.

leastWorthwhile.text: The third pole fitting repeated an already clear process, though it did show a physical change.

surprise.text: Nothing particularly surprised me; the fittings followed the stated goals.

arbitrary.text: None felt arbitrary: each fitting had a clear place in the carousel.

continue.text: I might continue for another construction, though this chapter's repeated fittings left little to figure out. The text made the assembly clear, but I cannot judge the pictures or hands-on experience from it.
